_readme: Runtime config for /llc-name-check and the single source of state filing fees for the Formation wizard (index.html STATES) and the server quote (netlify/lib/pricing.mjs). After changing filing_fee_usd or typical_yearly_cost_usd here, run `node scripts/sync-state-fees.mjs`. feesVerified:false hides every dollar amount on the name check; true lets each row's `verified` decide. See llc-name-check/README.md.
source: Free Tools agent, gtm/free-tools/llc-states.json (verified 2026-10-18; NM unverified)

states.notes: No documented free API. Use a deep link to the official search. Scraping not recommended; check the ToS/robots.txt (not verified per state). | Fees verified 2026-10-18 on official source: Filing $200 same paper and online (SOS LLC page/fee schedule; online adds card convenience fee 3%+$2). Old $50 'min' BPT applied only to tax year 2023; ADOR: for tax years beginning after 12/31/2023 BPT of $100 or less is fully exempt and no return required (Act 2022-252). Larger LLCs owe BPT based on net worth ($0.25-$1.75 per $1,000). Name reservation ($25 paper/$28 online) required before formation.
